This patch release raises the required Go version to 1.27.4. The API, behavior
and performance characteristics are unchanged from v1.1.1.

## Changes

- `go.mod` declares `go 1.27.4`. Go 1.27.4 carries security fixes to cgo, the go
  command, the compiler, the linker and `net/http`.
- The pinned CI report actions were updated. This does not affect the library.

## Compatibility

No source changes were made to the library. The module path remains
`github.com/soulteary/memfs-kit`, and there are still no dependencies outside
the Go standard library. Callers building with a toolchain older than Go 1.27.4
need to update it, or let the `go` command select the newer toolchain.

## Installation

Requires **Go 1.27.4 or newer**.

```sh
go get github.com/soulteary/memfs-kit@v1.1.2
```

```go
import memfs "github.com/soulteary/memfs-kit"
```

## Validation

Formatting, `go vet`, and the race-enabled test suite pass with Go 1.27.4 in CI.
No benchmarks were rerun for this release; the v1.1.1 measurements were taken
with Go 1.27.3 and are not restated for Go 1.27.4.
